extractions.value: Patient also had elevated CK level (785 IU/L) and anti-ssDNA (23.8) and anti-dsDNA (15.7) antibodies. Brainstem symptoms (dysphagia, dysarthria, glossal motor deficits) were temporary and resolved immediately after hospitalization on June 5. Bilateral pyramidal signs (Babinski, hyperreflexia) present at hospitalization resolved after IV diazepam. PER and neuromyotonia were ruled out as differential diagnoses.
